Avalugg

Ice

Kalos · Generation 6

Avalugg is an Ice-type Iceberg Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 505 kg. It evolves from Bergmite. Its highest base stat is Defense (184), with a base stat total of 514.
